p: Belshazzar the king made a great: Daniel recites this history of King Belshazzar, Evilmerodach's son, to show God's judgments against the wicked for the deliverance of his Church, and how the prophecy of Jeremiah was true, that they would be delivered after seventy years.

before the thousand: The kings of the east part then used to commonly sit alone, and disdained that any should sit in their company: and now to show his power, and how little he thought of his enemy, which then besieged Babylon, made a solemn banquet, and used excess in their company, which is meant here by drinking wine: thus the wicked are very lax in morals and negligent, when their destruction is at hand.
father Nebuchadnezzar had taken out of: Meaning his grandfather.

gods of gold: In contempt of the true God they praise their idols, not that they thought that the gold or silver were gods, but that there was a certain strength and power in them to do them good, which is also the opinion of all idolaters.
against the candlestick upon the plaister: That it might the better be seen.
knees smote one against another: So he that before condemned God, was moved by this sight to tremble for fear of God's judgments.
the astrologers: Thus the wicked in their troubles seek many means, which draw them from God, because they do not seek for him who is the only comfort in all afflictions.
queen: That is, his grandmother, Nebuchadnezzar's wife, who because of her age was not at the feast before, but came there when she heard of this strange news.
magicians: Read Da 4:6; and this declares that both this name was odious to him, and also he did not use these vile practises, because he was not among them when all were called.

the spirit of the gods is: For the idolaters thought that the angels had power as God, and therefore held them in the same estimation that they held God, thinking that the spirit of prophecy and understanding came from them.

Nebuchadnezzar thy father a kingdom: Before he read the writing, he declares to the king his great ingratitude toward God, who could not be moved to give him the glory, considering God's wonderful work toward his grandfather, and so shows that he does not sin from ignorance but from malice.
Then was the part of the: After God had for such a long time deferred his anger, and patiently waited for your repentance.

MENE: This word is written twice because of the certainty of the thing, showing that God had most surely decided: it signifies also that God has appointed a term for all kingdoms, and that a miserable end will come on all that raise themselves against him.
the Median took the kingdom: Cyrus his son-in-law gave him this title of honour, even though Cyrus in effect had the dominion.
